board: Sensirion SPS30 with its 5-wire JST ZHR-5 cable (e.g. SparkFun SEN-15103), I2C mode
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, PCB, footprint): float-mode start/data-ready/read-values commands with per-word Sensirion CRC modelled per datasheet section 6. External SDA/SCL pull-ups are required but pullUp was deliberately not set because Sparkbench would tie them to the 5 V supply; build notes tell the user to fit 10 kOhm to 3.3 V, and SEL is modelled as a GND pin.
breakoutPinoutSource: SPS30 datasheet v2.0 Table 4 (connector pins 1-5: VDD, SDA/RX, SCL/TX, SEL, GND); https://www.sparkfun.com/products/15103
